# anthropic_rate_limits (Data Source)

Organization rate limit groups. Read-only: limits cannot be changed through the API. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rate_limits" "all" {}

data "anthropic_rate_limits" "sonnet" {
  model = "claude-sonnet-5"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) Filter by group type: `batch`, `files`, `model_group`, `skills`, `token_count`, `web_search`.
- `model` (String) Filter to the group containing this model name or alias. Unknown models return an error.

### Read-Only

- `rate_limits` (Attributes List) Rate limit groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `group_type` (String) Group type.
- `id` (String) Rate limit group id.
- `limits` (Attributes List) Limiters in the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits--limits))
- `models` (List of String) Models in the group; null unless `group_type` is `model_group`.

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits.limits`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Limiter type, for example `requests_per_minute`.
- `value` (Number) Limit value.
